lines.text: Many learners say: We discussed about the plan.
Discuss! Let us discuss the problem.

native.tip: الفعل discuss لا يحتاج about: “We discussed the plan.” وليس “We discussed about the plan.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “We discussed about the plan.” 😅 الفعل discuss لا يحتاج about، فالجملة الصحيحة “We discussed the plan.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “We discussed about the plan”?
en.tip: The verb discuss needs no about: “We discussed the plan.” not “We discussed about the plan.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “We discussed about the plan.” 😅 The verb discuss needs no about, so the right sentence is “We discussed the plan.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
